title: No early return between moving a user file and writing its undo record
rule: When an action moves user files (to the trash, to another folder) and logs the moves for undo, never `?` out of the loop after a file has moved. Collect each move's result, then write the log and the index flags in one transaction after the loop; if that write fails, move the files back before returning the error. Add a test whose stand-in moves the files and then breaks the log table, and assert every file is back and nothing was announced.
rationale: E8.3 (#88): keep_copy marked each trashed file gone with its own UPDATE and `?` inside the loop and wrote the undo log after it; a database error after a successful move left the file in the trash with no resolution row, so the user could not undo it.
